introHtml: Steel Moscow mule mugs offer a classic look with the durability of stainless steel, making them ideal for corporate gifts, barware promotions, and event giveaways. Unlike ceramic or glass, steel mugs keep drinks cold longer and resist chipping. Decorate with your logo using engraving or screen printing for a polished, professional finish that stands up to repeated use.
